The organisation

The European Builders Confederation (EBC) is the association representing crafts, micro companies, and SMEs in the construction sector across Europe. EBC advocates for a more inclusive, sustainable, and digital construction sector and built environment, with small construction companies at its heart. Based in Brussels, our young and multicultural team is looking for a motivated professional to own our communications and events and support our EU-funded projects.

Familiar with the Brussels working environment? Enjoy organising events and engaging with audiences? Keen to contribute to EU-funded projects? We’d love to hear from you!

Your role

Communication & Events – Reporting to the Secretary General, you will lead EBC’s communications and events:

· Plan logistics, run and follow up on internal meetings and events, including EBC 3-day Congress

· Manage the publications calendar and coordinate team contributions

· Write, edit and proofread articles, position papers and newsletters

· Design visuals and communication materials

· Manage our website (WordPress) and social media (LinkedIn, X, Facebook)

· Liaise with specialised press and service providers

 EU-funded projects – Working closely with the EU Projects Officer, you will support EBC’s role in European projects:

· Lead communication and dissemination activities

· Work closely with partners across Europe

· Organise and promote conferences, workshops, trainings and webinars, from logistics to moderation

· Help track deadlines and deliverables

· Represent EBC at meetings and events in Brussels and across Europe

Additionally, you will support membership and network outreach as well as administrative and Secretariat tasks.

 
Your profile

You are a proactive professional with:

· At least 2 years’ experience in EU communications, EU-funded projects (Horizon Europe, Erasmus+) and/or event management

· A track record of juggling priorities and owning projects end to end

· A collaborative, hands-on attitude that thrives in a small team

· Excellent writing and editing skills, with a flair for concise, engaging content

· Creative digital skills, including social media and graphic design tools such as Canva

· Fluent English and a working knowledge of French; other EU languages are an asset

· Willingness to travel across Europe for project meetings and events (around 5 trips a year)

· Familiarity with Microsoft 365, WordPress, Mailchimp and Zoom

 
What we offer

· A full-time, long-term contract with a competitive salary based on experience, plus meal and eco-vouchers

· Flexible working, including partial remote work, with Brussels as the primary location

· Direct exposure to EU institutions, policymakers and project partners across Europe, with room to grow into a broader EU affairs role

Why join us?

At EBC, you will help shape the future of Europe’s construction sector. We are committed to an inclusive, welcoming workplace and do not discriminate on any basis.

Ready to take the next step in your EU career? We look forward to your application!

For more information, visit www.ebc-construction.eu.

MedTech Europe is looking for an intern to join its Legal and Compliance department.

Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and researching national legal and self-regulatory requirements relevant to healthcare industry in the area of antibribery compliance, including desk research to support periodic assessments of existing compliance practices and frameworks.
  • Providing day-to-day support to the legal & compliance team (e.g. coordinating input for internal and external newsletters, review, drafting and filing contracts; taking minutes; organising meetings; updating website, etc.)
  • Updating its annual publication on country rules on compliance, which includes liaising with all National Association members as well as desk research
  • Managing vendor and other contracts, incl. identifying and resolving standard contractual concerns with relevant colleagues
  • Assisting, as needed, in the review and evaluation of Events in the Conference Vetting System to ensure compliance with MedTech Europe’s and EFPIA’s ethical standards set out in the MedTech Europe Code of Ethical Practice and the EFPIA Healthcare Professionals Code of Practice, under the supervision of the CVS Compliance Officer and the Compliance Panel
  • Assisting, when necessary, the Legal & Compliance team with activities as well as support the team and relevant committees
  • The scope of responsibilities may be adjusted to reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience, as well as the evolving needs and priorities of the Legal & Compliance team.

Must-haves

  • Completed BA in Law
  • Fluent in oral and written English + at least one other EU language
  • Excellent research and drafting skills
  • IT-tools proficient
  • Well organised and detail-oriented
  • Ability to work in an autonomous way and look for support when necessary
  • Eligible to work as a trainee in Belgium
  • Strong communication skills, especially written
  • Nice to have: Interest in compliance, ethics and the healthcare industry

What we offer

  • A one-year full time contract under the Belgian Convention d’Immersion Professionnelle (CIP)
  • A valuable experience in a well-known trade association in Brussels
  • A remunerated internship with benefits: Lunch vouchers | Internet and phone compensation | Reimbursement of public transportation | Possibility of hybrid work
  • This internship is only applicable for candidates who hold a diploma and are not linked to any internship with a university.

About MedTech Europe

MedTech Europe is the European trade association representing the medical technology industries, from diagnosis to cure. We represent Diagnostics and Medical Devices manufacturers operating in Europe. MedTech Europe’s mission is to make innovative medical technology available to more people, while helping healthcare systems move towards a sustainable path. MedTech Europe encourages policies that help the medical technology industry meet Europe’s growing healthcare needs and expectations. It also promotes medical technology’s value for Europe focusing on innovation and stakeholder relations, using economic research and data, communications, industry events and training sessions. For more information, please visit: http://www.medtecheurope.org/

Elevate Philanthropy’s Fieldshaper Program turns generalist, high-agency professionals into field-leading grantmakers in global aid policy.

  • Format: One-year, full-time fellowship (February 2027 to January 2028)
  • Role: As a Grantmaker-in-Residence, you’ll steward US$1,000,000 in grant capital within a given sub-field, much like a foundation program officer or the lead of a philanthropic fund
  • Salary: $125,000
  • Training: A six-week intensive bootcamp, then live grantmaking supported by weekly structured sessions and coaching
  • Approach: Active grantmaking, sourcing and building opportunities rather than waiting for proposals
  • Countries/Organisations of Focus for Aid Policy: Tier I: Germany, EU, Nordics, Netherlands | Tier II: UK, Italy, Spain, France, Japan, South Korea
  • Outcomes: A grant portfolio, a published piece of thought leadership and the track record to shape your field
  • Experience: Prior grantmaking experience is not required
